environment.runtime: Actual native main/preload/production renderer on macOS27.2 arm64/Electron43.7.0
environment.profiles: Fresh isolated encrypted connection and dummy provider keys; shared keychain adapter disabled; owned local music HTTP server; hidden muted windows
environment.generation: Controlled HN/text/voice replies prepare one saved test artifact per variant; no real source/provider networking
environment.deletion: UI confirmation/Cancel/Delete; actual IPC/storage/media protocol; generation counters unchanged during deletion

review.Elena: Reviewed actual condition/copy against storage synchronization; no actionable defect.
review.implementation: Primary applied existing DJ-deletion pattern; no backend mutation change.

verificationCorrections: Sources is a Settings navigation button, not a tab.
Configuration comparisons exclude progressing music transport state.
CSP blocks renderer fetch; actual Audio element decodes saved media metadata instead.
Restart comparisons use JSON-equivalent objects because durable JSON omits undefined optional fields.

acceptance.S11: Controlled: multi-profile reference cleanup, other setup/history, safe selected playback and restart.

limits: Muted controlled generation does not prove paid-provider delivery or audible quality.
No observed regular-user comprehension or full screen-reader run.
